questions.text: Do you have chest pain or pressure right now that could be a heart attack?
Do you have signs of a stroke right now, such as a drooping face, weakness in an arm, or slurred speech?
Are you having severe difficulty breathing right now?
Are you having a severe allergic reaction right now, such as swelling of the lips, tongue or throat?
Have you collapsed or lost consciousness today, or are you being asked these questions on behalf of someone who has?
Do you have severe bleeding that will not stop?
Are you in immediate danger of seriously harming yourself?
In the last few days, have you had what could be a serious side effect from a medicine, such as a new rash with a high temperature, yellowing skin or eyes, or unusual bleeding or bruising?
Have you recently taken too much of a medicine, the wrong medicine, or a medicine at the wrong time in a way that could cause harm?
Have you run out, or will you run out in the next 2 days, of a medicine you must not miss (for example insulin, epilepsy medicine or a blood thinner), with no way to get more?
Do you have new or worsening symptoms that you think need to be checked by a doctor or nurse today?
Do you take any medicines that need extra care, such as a blood thinner, insulin, methotrexate, lithium or a strong painkiller?
Do you take 10 or more different medicines, including ones you buy yourself?
Are you meant to have regular blood tests or check-ups for a medicine, but have not had one when expected?
Do you find it hard to manage your medicines on your own, for example because of memory problems or living alone?
Are you pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning a pregnancy?
